title: AI Enters the Fed’s Spotlight—3 Wild Scenarios That Could Shift Your Portfolio
author: Eastern-Apartment934
selftext: Fed Chair just broke down three AI-driven economic outlooks: a full productivity boom, faster growth paired with job losses, or a brutal AI bubble bust. [This isn’t official forecast, but it’s a huge shift—Fed is now actively factoring AI into its policy playbook](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004875575?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D). Are we overestimating near-term AI returns, or are those productivity gains actually going to land? Keep an eye on realized earnings and real-world adoption beyond the tech sector to gauge which scenario we’re tipping into.

comments.author: Mental-Doughnut4657
comments.body: How to solve the two opposite problems of technology changing the future and technology accelerating the foam economy
